group_assessment.weighting: A paediatric neurology group with a registered systematic review (PROSPERO) of B6-dependent epilepsies; adjacent-method expertise for how a vitamin trial is interpreted, not a WWOX group. Observation (counted published cases) is weighted above interpretation (early trial gives a better outcome), which rests on a retrospective pool without comparator.

entries.proposition: SUBSTITUTE. What a pyridoxine response is in this class: of 312 treated patients, complete seizure freedom in 173 and a significant reduction in 38 (about 55% and 12%); the response is a seizure endpoint only, and the Background states it can be incomplete or delayed for up to 3 weeks and does not include other manifestations.
entries.snippet: Complete seizure freedom was observed in 173 patients, while a significant seizure reduction occurred in 38 patients
